overview:
**High fire danger today, driven by very dry fuels (82% ERC) and low humidity, with a jump to Very High expected midweek.**
- Fire danger rises to Very High Wednesday–Thursday as ERC and BI percentiles peak near 91-92%, then ease back to High through the weekend.
- Winds stay light out of the NE (8-13 mph), but afternoon humidity drops as low as 12% Wednesday-Thursday, the week's driest stretch.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM lands across Montrose, Delta, Mesa, Gunnison, Ouray and San Miguel counties, after being lowered from Stage 2 on Sept. 4-5; GMUG National Forest lands removed all fire restrictions effective September 3, 2026.
- The Elk Fire, seven miles northwest of Lake City in Hinsdale County, is at 7,257 acres and 73% contained; some structures remain threatened with area, road and trail closures in effect.
